_comment: Declared RPM Requires that the shipped image intentionally leaves unsatisfied, per package.
krb5-libs reaches the image only as a library dependency of the python3.12 'nis' extension
module; its manual Requires on shell tools exist for krb5's configuration scriptlets and CLI
helpers, none of which ship or run here (scriptlets are suppressed and the tools are stripped
build-support packages). The CI functional battery proves ssl/hashlib/TLS operate without them.
Any addition to this file requires re-review; the build fails on unsatisfied Requires not
listed here and on listed entries that are unexpectedly satisfied.
python3.12-libs declares /usr/bin/sh solely via the shebang auto-dependency of the packaged
developer helper /usr/lib64/python3.12/ctypes/macholib/fetch_macholib, which the runtime never
executes; the image intentionally ships no shell (same posture as the parent's glibc-common).
python3.12-libs declares both a manual sqlite-libs dependency and an automatic
libsqlite3.so.0()(64bit) dependency solely for the optional _sqlite3 extension. The exact
retained-payload trim removes that extension, its build-id link, and the sqlite3 Python package
before ELF closure derivation, so neither SQLite Requires has a surviving consumer.
